regulatoryFrameworks.name: ICMR National Ethical Guidelines for Biomedical and Health Research Involving Human Participants (2017)
ICMR Ethical Guidelines for Application of Artificial Intelligence in Biomedical Research and Healthcare (2023)

requiredDossierDocuments: Formal Application for Waiver of Informed Consent

medvoice_synthetic_fixtures.name: MedVoice Synthetic Clinical Benchmark Fixtures
medvoice_synthetic_fixtures.actualLegalTerms: Proprietary internal research fixtures; synthetic clinician-crafted test cases. Permitted for internal engineering and regression testing.
restrictions: Do not publish proprietary internal clinical test vectors without blinding
medvoice_synthetic_fixtures.notes: Fully synthetic, zero-PHI, zero-human-subjects. Authorized immediately for Stage 1 engineering.

medlineplus_xml.name: MedlinePlus Clinical Reference Summaries
medlineplus_xml.actualLegalTerms: Public domain in the United States under 17 U.S.C. 105. Subject to NLM terms of service and standard attribution.
restrictions: Do not assert NIH/NLM endorsement of algorithmic recommendations
Preserve NLM copyright notice and metadata attribution
medlineplus_xml.notes: Medical reference data only; no human subject dialogues.

mtsamples.name: MTSamples Medical Transcription Dataset
mtsamples.actualLegalTerms: Proprietary website terms: educational sharing with attribution; non-commercial use only. Corpus-scale ingestion, automated scraping, or model ingestion requires express written permission or formal Data Use Agreement (DUA).
provenanceChain: Unofficial Third-Party Kaggle Mirror (Unsubstantiated CC0 claim)
permittedUses: Pending DUA Execution: Offline schema review only
restrictions: Corpus-scale ingestion is prohibited without executed written DUA
Must verify de-identification safeguards prior to pipeline entry
mtsamples.notes: CRITICAL: Must NOT be treated as CC0. Corpus ingestion blocked until written agreement is secured.

healthcaremagic_100k.name: HealthCareMagic-100k (ChatDoctor Distribution)
healthcaremagic_100k.actualLegalTerms: Upstream teleconsultation portal Terms of Service retain proprietary rights over patient interactions. Academic redistribution by ChatDoctor is restricted strictly to non-commercial academic research.
provenanceChain: ChatDoctor Research Team (Yunxiang Li et al., 2023, arXiv:2303.14070)
permittedUses: Pending IEC Approval: Retrospective non-commercial research alignment benchmarking only
restrictions: Ingestion blocked until formal IEC Waiver of Consent is granted
Must undergo automated PhiScrubber pass and manual sampling review before ingestion
Raw dialogues must never be committed to source code repositories
healthcaremagic_100k.notes: Authentic patient-doctor teleconsultations. Ingestion gated by IEC protocol review.

meddialog_original.name: MedDialog Dataset (Original UCSD-AI4H Release)
meddialog_original.actualLegalTerms: Original authors explicitly specify: 'The copyright of the data remains with the original websites (HealthCareMagic, iCliniq, Haodf). The data is released for research purposes only.'
provenanceChain: UCSD-AI4H Research Team (Guangtao Zeng, Shen Gao et al., 2020, arXiv:2004.03329)
permittedUses: Pending IEC Approval: Non-commercial academic research benchmarking
restrictions: Copyright retained by original teleconsultation websites
Requires IEC review and waiver of consent
meddialog_original.notes: Original research release with documented provenance. Ingestion gated by Gate 0.

meddialog_repackaged.name: MedDialog Repackaged (OpenMed / Third-Party HF Mirrors)
meddialog_repackaged.actualLegalTerms: Legally invalid license claims. Third-party aggregators cannot confer MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses on underlying copyrighted patient consultations without authorization from HealthCareMagic/iCliniq.
provenanceChain: Third-party repackagers / aggregators (OpenMed, Hugging Face community)
restrictions: PERMANENTLY BLOCKED from MedVoice evaluation pipelines
Do not ingest or download repackaged/tainted distributions
meddialog_repackaged.notes: Tainted provenance chain. Repackagers do not own underlying rights.

mimic_iv_notes.name: PhysioNet MIMIC-IV-Note
mimic_iv_notes.actualLegalTerms: Strict credentialed access; human subjects training (CITI) required; signed Data Use Agreement; individual researcher credentialing; prohibited re-identification; prohibited redistribution.
restrictions: BLOCKED until all evaluating investigators complete CITI training and sign PhysioNet DUA
Strict prohibition of raw data sharing outside certified enclave
mimic_iv_notes.notes: High-standard clinical EHR dataset. Kept blocked until formal credentialing.
